{{Top|leg}}
'''Protein paste''' was an edible [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was created by the mutant [[fefze beetle]]s of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. The [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] were able to convert any organic material into protein paste.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
